release_notes: Fix: email logo sent as cid-embedded attachment instead of rendering inline sendMail() embedded the site logo as a MIME inline image (addEmbeddedImage + cid: rewrite) so it would still show up for recipients blocking remote images. Some webmail clients (observed on Gmail) fail to resolve the cid: reference and instead surface the embedded file as a literal email attachment, with the logo's alt text shown as broken link text in its place. Logo now stays a plain remote built by finalEmailMessage(), same as any other image in the email body -- no MIME attachment involved.
